import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_A = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD_B = 1000000007L;
    static long answerSum = 0;
    static long totalN;
    static long counter = 0;
    static List<Long>[] valuesArr = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] sumValuesArr = new long[7];
    static int[] powTenLocal = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static long count2Local = -1;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            valuesArr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void build(int level, long prefixSum) {
        if (level == 7) return;
        long val = (counter - prefixSum + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
        valuesArr[level].add(val);
        sumValuesArr[level] += val;
        counter++;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            build(level + 1, prefixSum * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static boolean inRangeCheck(long x) {
        long half = 1000000L;
        return x * half + 999999L <= totalN && x * half * 10 > totalN;
    }

    static void dfsExplore(int level, long num) {
        if (num > totalN) return;
        if (inRangeCheck(num)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long offset = ((count2Local + 1 - (num * powTenLocal[i]) % MOD_A) + MOD_A) % MOD_A;
                List<Long> arr = valuesArr[i];
                int pos = lowerBound(arr, (MOD_A - offset) % MOD_A);
                long sumVal = (sumValuesArr[i] + offset * arr.size() - MOD_B * (arr.size() - pos)) % MOD_B;
                answerSum = (answerSum + sumVal) % MOD_B;
            }
            count2Local += counter;
        } else {
            count2Local++;
            answerSum = (answerSum + ((count2Local - num) % MOD_A + MOD_A) % MOD_A) % MOD_B;
            for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
                if (level == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                dfsExplore(level + 1, num * 10 + d);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        totalN = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        build(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(valuesArr[i]);
        }
        count2Local = -1;
        dfsExplore(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answerSum);
    }
}
